front_matter.text: Hawe P'awuloosi S'imootoosaw s'aafeedda laa'entso kiitay, P'awuloosi mata barena maaddiyaanne oosuwaa barenanna ittippe ootsiyaa wodalla, S'imootoosa zoreedda zoriyaa oyk'k'eeddawaa. Aa zoriyaappe dariyaa baggay danddayaan genc'c'ana bessee giyaawaa. S'imootoosaw zoriyaanne mentsetsuwaa k'aalay imetteeddawe, Yesuusi Kiristtoosabaa ammanettiyaawaa gidiide markkattanaadan, Mishiraachchuwaa K'aalaanne Ec'a K'aalaa C'aak'uwaa timirttiyaa minisiide oyk'k'anaadaaninne metiyaabaynne ek'ettiyaabay darooppekka tamaarissiyaawaaninne Mishiraachchuwaa K'aalaa odiyaawaan minnanaassa.
S'imootoosi eeyatetsaan oosettiyaa patsenna mela palumaappe haakkana mala, dumma mino oduu aw odetteedda. Ayaw gooppe, hewaa mala oduu sisiyaawantta bayizziyaawaappe attin, hara I immiyaa go"i baawa.

Hewan ubbaan S'imootoosi hassayanaw bessiyaabay P'awuloosa de'uwaanne Aa hanotaa lo"o k'ofaa, hewaappekka Aa ammanuwaa, Aa genc'c'uwaa, Aa siik'uwaa Aa danddayaanne yedesaan Aa gakkeedda metuwaa leemisuwaan kaallanaadaana.
He wode de'iyaabatuwaanne koshshiyaa kaaletsiyaa ogatuwaa 4:6-18

verses.text: Taani P'awuloosi, S'oossay immana geedda Kiristtoosi Yesuusanna nuw de'iyaa de'uwaabaa odanaw, S'oossay geeddawaadan, Kiristtoosi Yesuusi kiitteeddawe,
ta siik'o na'aa S'imootoosaw ha dabddaabbiyaa s'aafay.

continuations.text: S'oossaa Aawuwaappenne nu Godaa Kiristtoosi Yesuusappe, aad'd'o keekatetsay, maarotetsaynne sarotetsay new gido.

verses.text: Ta zaratuu ootseeddawaadan, taanikka taana zoriyaa geeshsha wozanaappe ootsiyaa S'oossaa k'ammanne gallassi woossiyaa woosaan ubbaa wode neena hassayiyaa diraw, Aa galatay.
Taani ne afotsaa hassaya hassayaade nashettana mala, neena be'anaw daro laamotay.
Neenan de'iyaa worddo baynna ammanuwaa hassayay. He ammanuu beni ne daay daay Loydininne ne daay Ewuniik'in de'iyaa ammanuwaa mala; k'ay neenankka hewe de'iyaawaa eraad.
Hewaa diraw, taani ta kushiyaa laa"uwaa ne bolla wotseedda wode, S'oossay new immeedda imuwaa neeni doshissenna mala, neena hassayissay.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay nuw wolk'k'aa, siik'uwaanne nu huup'iyaa naagiyaawaa immiyaa Geeshsha Ayaanaa immeeddappe attin, yashshaa ayaanaa immibeenna.
Simmi, nu Godaw markkattiyaawaan woy Aa diraw k'ashuwaan de'iyaa tawaankka yeellatoppa. Shin S'oossay new immiyaa wolk'k'aa keenaan taananna mishiraachchuwaa k'aalaw waayetta.

S'oossay bare k'ofaaninne bare aad'd'o keekatetsan nuuna ashshiide, bare asaa ootsanaw s'eesowaappe attin, nuuni ootseedda oosuwaa diraw gidenna. I ha aad'd'o keekatetsaa Kiristtoosi Yesuusa baggana wodii doomettanaappe kase nuw immeedda.

Shin ha"i ha aad'd'o keekatetsay nuuna ashshiyaa Kiristtoosi Yesuusa yuussaan nuw k'onc'c'eedda. K'ay hayk'uwaa wolk'k'aakka I d'ayisseedda. Wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa baggana bayenna de'uwaa nuw k'onc'c'isseedda.
Taani Yesuusi kiitteeddawaanne Ayihuda gidenna asaa tamaarissiyaawaa gidaade, wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa odana mala, S'oossay taana dooreedda.
K'ay taani ha metuwaa akkiyaawe hewaa diraassa. Shin taani ammaneeddawaa eriyaa diraw, yeellatikke. K'ay I taw immeedda hadaraa he gallassay gakkanaw, I naaganaw danddayiyaawaa eray.
Taani neena tamaarisseedda tumu k'aalaa leemisuwaa uda oyk'k'aade, Kiristtoosi Yesuusan nuw de'iyaa ammanuwaaninne siik'uwaan de'a.
Nu giddon de'iyaa Geeshsha Ayaanaa baggana new hadaraa immeedda lo"obaa naaga.
Iisiyaa giyaa biittaan de'iyaa ubbatuu taappe bak'ateeddawaa eraasa; unttunttu giddon Pigeluusinne Hermogeneesi de'iino.
Henesifooru taana daro wode mentsetseedda diraw, Goday Aa soy asaw maarotetsaa immo. K'ay taani k'asho gollen de'iyaawaa I yeellatibeenna.
Shin Roome giyaa katamaa gakkeeddasaanna taana loytsi koyyiide demmeedda.
He gallassi Godaappe maarotetsaa demmanaadan, Goday aw immo. K'ay Efesoona giyaa katamaan I taana ay keenaa maaddeeddenttonne neeni loytsa eraasa.

notes.text: + Taani ta kushiyaa laa"uwaa ne bolla wotseedda wode: Hawe bessiyaawe, ammaniyaa asaa kaaletsanaadan Geeshsha Ayyaanay oosoo doorina tumatetsaan kaaletsiyaawanttu K'aalaa odanaw woy tamaarissanaw S'oossay okkeeddawanttu bollan barenttu kushiyaa wotsiide woossiyaawaa bessee. 1 S'im. 1:4 S'eellite.

verses.text: Simmi ta na'aw, Kiristtoosi Yesuusan de'iyaa aad'd'o keekatetsan minna.
K'ay daro markkatuu de'iyaa saan taappe neeni siseedda yewatuwaa haratuwaa tamaarissanaw danddayiyaa ammanetteeda asatoo hadaraa imma.
Kiristtoosa Yesuusaw ammanetteeda wotaadaraadan, taananna waayetta.
Olaa biyaa wotaadaray bare kaappuwaa nashechchanaw, wotaadara gidenna Asay ootsiyaa kiitaan walakettenna.
K'ay wotsaan keesetiyaa uraykka wogaadan wos's'ana d'ayooppe, woytaa akkena.
Daro daaburiide ootseedda biittaa goshiyaa bitanii shiik'eedda katsaappe barena gakkiyaawaa koyro akkanaw bessee.
Neeni ubbabaa akeekanaadan, Goday neena danddayissana diraw, taani giyaawaa k'oppa.
Taani wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa odiyaawaadan, hayk'uwaappe denddeedda Daawite zariyaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosa k'oppa.
Taani wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa odiyaa diraw, iitabaa ootseeddawaadan, haray atto k'ashettana gakkanaw waayettay. Shin S'oossaa k'aalay k'ashettenna.
Hewaa diraw, taani S'oossay dooreedda asatuukka Kiristtoosi Yesuusan de'iyaa atotetsaa med'inaa bonchchuwaanna demmanaadan, unttunttu diraw, taani ubbabaan waayettay.
Hawe,
Nuuni genc'c'ooppe,
Nuuni ammanettennaan aggooppekka,

continuations.text: Ayaw gooppe, I barena bare huup'ew

verses.text: Neeni ne asaa hawaa hassayissa; unttunttu k'aalaan palumettenna mala, S'oossaa sintsan zora. Hewe sisiyaa asaa bayizziyaawaappe attin, ayinne go"enna.
Neeni S'oossaa tumatetsaa k'aalaa suuretetsaan odiyaawaanne k'ay Aa oosoo yeellatenna oosanchcha gidaade, S'oossay sabbiyaa asaadan, ne huup'iyaa S'oossaw immanaw minna.
Shin ha sa'aw injjetiyaa maaddenna haasayaappe neena naaga. Ayaw gooppe, hewe S'oossaappe asaa haassee.
K'ay unttunttu tamaarissiyaawe bollaa c'ittuwaadan ubbasaa gakkanaassa. He tamaarissiyaawanttuppe laa"atuu Hemeneyoosanne Piliis'oosa.
Unttunttu tumuwaa ogiyaa aggiide, «Hayk'uwaappe denddiyaawe kase aad'd'idiggeedda» yaagiide amareeda ammaniyaa asatuwaa ammanuwaa bayizziino.
Gidooppekka, S'oossay esseedda mino tuussay k'aas's'ana danddayenna. K'ay Aa bollan, «Goday barewantta eree»; k'ay «Godaawaa gidiyaa ooninne iita oosuwaa aggo» yaagiyaa K'aalatuu s'aafetteeddino.

Itti wolk'k'aama gollen work'k'aappenne biraappe med'etteedda miishshaa s'alalaa gidennaan, mitsaappenne urk'k'aappe med'etteedda miishshatuukka de'iino. Hewanttuppe baggatuu bonchcho oosuwaa unttunttun ootsanaw, k'ay baggatuu tooshettiyaabaa unttunttun ootsanaw med'etteeddino.

Hewaa diraw, ooninne ha iitabaa ubbaappe barena geeshshooppe, I bare Godaa go"iyaa oosuwaa ootsanaw barena immeedda diraw, bonchcho oosuwaa ootsiyaa miishshaa gidanawaa. K'ay lo"o oosuwaa ubbaa ootsanaw giigetteeddawaa gidanawaa.
Shin neeni iita wodallatetsaa amuwaappe bak'ata. Barentta maaddanaw geeshsha wozanaappe Godaa s'eesisiyaawanttunna ittippe, s'illotetsaa, ammanuwaa, siik'otetsaanne sarotetsaa minisaade kaala.
Shin eeyatuwaa palumiinne ayinne erennawanttu palumii walassaa kaaletsiyaawaa eraade aappe bak'ata.
Godaa k'oomay ubbaw keekiyaawaa, loytsi tamaarissiyaawaanne danddayanchcha gidanaw besseeppe attin, walak'ettanaw bessena.
K'ay I barena is's'iyaawantta ashikketetsan seeriyaawaa gidanaw bessee. Unttunttu barenttu nagaraappe simmiide, tumatetsaa eranaadan S'oossay ootsanentto, ooni eri.
K'ay unttunttu barenttu wozanaa k'ofaw simmiide, unttuntta bare koyyeeddabaw azazettana mala oyk'k'eedda s'alahiyaa kaappuwaa dabaappe kessi akkana.

heading: Kiristtoosaw Lo"o Wotaadara Gidiide Metuwaa Akkiyaawaa

verses.text: Shin wurssetsa gallassi waayissiyaa wodii yaanawaa akeeka.

Ayaw gooppe, Asay barena siik'iyaawantta, shaluwaa siik'iyaawantta, c'eek'ettiyaawantta, ayyiyaawantta, boriyaawantta, barena yeleeddawanttoo azazettenawantta, galatennawantta, geeshshatetsay baynnawantta,
siik'uu baynnawantta, sigettennawantta, zigirssanchchatuwaa, barena naagennawantta, keekennawantta, lo"obaa dosennawantta,
ubbaa erikke giyaawantta, dirbbiyaawantta, otoruwaan sugettiyaawantta, k'ay S'oossaappe aatsiide, ishaluwaa dosiyaawantta gidana.
Unttunttu S'oossaw goyinniyaawaa malatiino; shin Aa wolk'k'aa kaddeeddino. Hewanttu mala asatuwaakko shiik'oppa.

Ayaw gooppe, unttunttuppe ittuu ittuu asaa golliyaa geliide, nagaray dees'eeddawantta, dumma dumma amuwaan sugettiyaawantta, ubbaa wode tamaariide, tumatetsaa era akkanaw mule danddayibeenna daaburanchcha mac'c'awantta baletsiino.
Yaaneesinne Yambbareesi Muse yewuwaa p'alk'k'owaadan, hewaadan k'ay hawanttu, suure k'ofay baynnawantta ammanuwaan kunddeeddawanttu, tumatetsaabaa p'alk'k'iino.
Shin Yaaneesa eeyatetsaynne Yambbareesa eeyatetsay k'ay k'onc'c'eeddawaadan, unttunttu eeyatetsaykka asaa ubbaw k'onc'c'ana diraw, unttunttu kasewaappe aad'd'iide dic'c'ikkino.
Shin neeni ta timirttiyaa, ta hanotaanne ta k'ofaa, ta ammanuwaanne ta danddayaa, ta siik'uwaanne ta genc'c'uwaa,
ta yedesaanne ta waayiyaa be'aadda. Ans's'ookiyaanne, Ik'ooniyoonenne Liss's'iraa giyaa katamatuwaan taana gakkeeddabaanne taani danddayeedda yedesaa eraasa. Goday taana he ubbaappe ashsheeda.
Tumatetsaan Kiristtoosi Yesuusan S'oossaa malatiide de'anaw dosiyaa ubbay yederssettana.
Shin iita asatuunne baletsiyaawanttu haratuwaa baletsiiddenne barenttu huup'ew baliidde, kaseppe iiti iiti biino.
Shin neeni he tumatetsaa ooppe tamaareeddenttonne eraade, neeni tamaareeddawaaninne ereeddawaan minnaade de'a.
Neeni guutsa na'atetsaappe doommaade Kiristtoosi Yesuusa ammanaade, atotetsay beettiyaa aad'd'eedda eraa immanaw danddayiyaa Geeshsha Mas'aafatuwaa eraadda.

S'oossaa Mas'aafaa ubbaan S'oossaa Ayyaanay de'ee. K'ay he mas'aafatuu S'oossaw ootsiyaa Asay kumentsanne lo"o oosuwaa ubbaw giigeeddawaa gidana mala, tumatetsaa tamaarissanaw, balaa seeranaw, bayizzuwaa suurissanawunne s'illotetsaa de'oo zoriyaa immanaw maaddiino.

notes.text: + Yaaneesinne Yambbareesi: Ha suntsatuu Ec'a C'aak'uwaa Mas'aafan baawa. Shin c'ora Asay giyaa k'ofay, «Hawanttu Muse Israa'eeliyaa asaa Gibs'eppe kessiide kaaletsanaw k'oppeedda wode, aanana ek'etteedda muruniyaawantta» yaagiyaawaana. Kes. 7:11, 12 s'eellite.

heading: Wurssetsa Gallassatuwaan Hananaw // De'iyaa Iita Yewatuwaa

verses.text: Taani neena S'oossaa sintsaaninne, de'uwaan de'iyaa asaanne hayk'k'eedda asaa pirddanaw de'iyaa Kiristtoosi Yesuusa sintsan, k'ay Aa yuussaaninne Aa kawutetsaan neena zoray.
K'aalaa oda. Wodii injjetina injjetana d'ayina, minnaade oda. Daro danddayan asaa tamaarissaadde suurissa, seeranne zora.
Ayaw gooppe, Asay tumu timirttiyaa sisennaan is's'iyaa wodii yaanawaa. Shin Asay barenttu amuwaa kaalliide, sisanaw nashechchiyaawaa odiyaa tamaarissiyaawantta gujji gujji shiishshana.
Unttunttu tumu yewuwaa sisiyaawaa aggiide, tossaa sisanaw barenttu haytsaa wora zaarana.
Shin neeni ubbabaan ne huup'iyaa naaganaw bessee. Waayiyaa danddaya. Wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa odiyaawe ootsiyaa oosuwaa ootsa. S'oossaa k'oomaadan, ne ootsiyaa oosuwaa ubbaa pola.
Taana gidooppe, ta suutsay gukkiide yarshshettiyaa wodiinne k'ay ha de'uwaa aggaade biyaa wodii gakkeedda.
Taani lo"o baas'iyaa baas'etaaddi; wotsaa wos's'aadde wurssaad; ammanuwaakka naagaad.
Sintsappe taw s'illotetsaa kalachchay giigi utteedda. Hewaa s'illo pirddaa pirddiyaa Goday he gallassi taw immana. K'ay Kiristtoosi k'onc'c'anawaa dosiyaa ubba saappe attin, ta s'alalaassa gidenna.
Taakko ellekka yaanaw minna.
Ayaw gooppe, Deemaasi ha alamiyaa dosiide, taana aggiide, Teselonk'k'e giyaa katamaa beedda. K'erk'k'iisi Galaatiyaa giyaa gadiyaa biina, k'ay Tiito Dilmaas'iyaa giyaa gadiyaa beedda.
Luk'aasa s'alalay taananna de'ee. Mark'k'oossi taana kiitaan loytsi maaddanaw danddayiyaa diraw, Aa demmaade neenanna akkaade ya.
Shin taani Tikik'oosa Efesoona giyaa katamaa kiittaad.

Neeni yaadde, S'iro'aadaa giyaa katamaan Karppoosawan taani yeggaade yeedda ta gaabiyaanne k'ay mas'aafatuwaa taw akkaade ya. Shin dummayaade galbbaan s'aafetteedda mas'aafatuwaa ayaa giddoppenne, akkenaan yooppa.
Birataa k'os's'iyaa Iskkinddiri taana daro k'oheedda; Goday aw Aa oosuwaadan zaarana.
I nuuni odiyaawaa loytsi p'alk'k'iyaa diraw, neeni aappe neena naaga.
Koyro taana mootiyaa wode, ubbaykka aggeeddawaappe attin, taana ooninne maaddibeenna. S'oossay hewaa unttunttoo paydoppo.
Shin taani kumentsaa kiitaa Ayihuda gidenna Asay ubbay sisanaw odana mala, Goday ta matan ek'k'iide, taw wolk'k'aa immeedda. K'ay gaammuwaa doonaappekka taana ashsheeda.
Goday taana iitabaa ubbaappe ashshiide, bare saluwaa kawutetsaa sarotetsaan afana; aw med'i med'inaw bonchchuu gido. Amen"i.
P'irisk'k'illiw, Ak'iilassinne Henesifooru soy asaw ta sarotaa oda.
Erass's'oosi K'oronttoosa giyaa katamaan atteedda. Shin S'irofiimoosi saketteedda diraw, Miliis'e giyaa katamaan Aa wotsaad.
Balgguu wod'd'anaappe kase yaanaw minna.

continuations.text: Ewubuluusi, P'udeesi, Liinoosinne K'ilawude k'ay hara ishatuu ubbaykka neena saro saro giino.

verses.text: Goday ne ayyaanaanna gido. Aad'o keekatetsay hinttenanna ubbaanna gido. Amen"i.
